gaps.text: A session resumed in a fresh process (hermes chat --resume, per-turn cron harnesses) still gets the horizon injected exactly once
gaps.details: Skip-on-first-sight cursor (adapters/hermes/deep_horizon.py:584-600 @ 42b32a9) suppresses injection forever on restored sessions — demonstrated live 2026-09-10 (session 20260910_122553_4fc2c8: 2-turn resume sequence, NO horizon, no sidecar; board t_6e908a4c orchestrator note item 4). Proposed replacement (transcript-verified dedup: mark seen only if the exact block already appears in restored api_content) never landed; no card tracked it. Done = a resumed 2-turn session shows horizon exactly once in transcript and sidecar.

gaps.text: Hermes core bugs the adapter works around are fixed upstream, or the workarounds are retired
gaps.details: Two hermes-agent core defects: (a) cli.py:853 calls async _on_session_finalize synchronously — coroutine never awaited, CLI sessions never write session-end records; adapter works around via flat-kwargs + sync def (deep_horizon.py:299-315). (b) cold-process plugin_manager discover_and_load(force=False) raises 'system prompt section horizon-line is already registered' (t_55708e55 OPEN RISK, deliberately unpatched). Done = both fixed in hermes-agent releases this adapter runs against, workaround code removed or reduced to a compat shim with a linked upstream issue.

gaps.text: Every published npm version has a matching git tag
gaps.details: SECURITY.md:18 tells reporters to target 'the latest tag', but the only tag is v0.2.0, 38 commits behind main; 0.4.0 published 2026-09-15 untagged (verified 2026-09-23, t_1e477567). Done = git tag v0.4.0 exists on the publish commit 51194c3 (or main), pushed, and SECURITY.md:18 references resolve.

about: A CLI plus per-harness adapters that keep a project's aim — one about line, up to 5 gaps — in front of every agent session, from one shared .horizon store
